trust_decision.summary: Do not expand environment variables (or a leading ~) in a URL or path that came from an untrusted caller before it is handed to git or written into git config; decided at each caller by calling Git.polish_url(..., expand_vars=False), with the flag threaded down through cygpath/_cygexpath for Cygwin.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names Repo.create_remote() and Remote.add(); both reach this single Git.polish_url call inside Remote.create (git/remote.py:785-814), so an engineer reading only the summary starts here.

fix_sites.entry_point: Repo._clone post-clone config rewrite (reached from every clone route)
fix_sites.module_kind: repository API, save/reload of cloned config

fix_sites.entry_point: git.util._cygexpath (via cygpath, via Git.polish_url on Cygwin)
git.util.cygpath (public util; also called directly from git/repo/base.py:238 and git/repo/fun.py:121)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: cygpath in git/util.py is a Cygwin/Windows repo-path converter, not a remote-URL helper, so a solver can argue a remote-URL rule does not reach it - and its two other in-tree callers (git/repo/base.py:238, git/repo/fun.py:121) still expand with the flag unthreaded.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: polish_url must keep expanding a leading ~ / $HOME and keep converting Cygwin and Windows path forms for local filesystem paths (clone destination, separate_git_dir); making expand_vars=False the default, or dropping expanduser/cygpath, breaks local clones and every Windows/Cygwin path conversion.

O6_input_shapes: leading ~ replaced via expanduser when expand_vars is true
Cygwin forms handled by cygpath: $VAR/repo, user@example.com:$VAR/repo, D:\... and \\?\UNC\...

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Repo.clone_from(..., separate_git_dir=...) still runs the caller-supplied directory through Git.polish_url with the default expand_vars=True, so env vars expand into a path that git clone then writes into the new repo's config/.git file
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: separate_git_dir is a local destination directory, not a remote URL, so the advisory's URL rule is argued not to apply
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function as the fixed clone sink, 18 lines above git/repo/base.py:1468

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Repo.clone_from(..., to_path) on Cygwin with bare= polishes the destination path with the default expand_vars=True
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Cygwin-only and a local path, so it is argued out of a remote-URL advisory
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function as the fixed clone sink, 21 lines above git/repo/base.py:1468

O8_uncovered_routes.route: git.util.cygpath called directly (Repo.__init__ / find_submodule_git_dir) still expands env vars unconditionally because the new expand_vars flag is only threaded from Git.polish_url
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: repo-path expansion was the subject of the earlier advisory GHSA-rwj8-pgh3-r573, not this URL advisory
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: git/repo/base.py top of file vs the clone code at 1423-1510, same file

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Remote.set_url / Remote.add_url write a caller-supplied URL straight into .git/config with no polish_url call at all
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a maintainer touching the URL-write family would naturally add the same polish_url(..., expand_vars=False) here for consistency with Remote.create 170 lines above

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Submodule.update writes the .gitmodules url into the parent .git/config without polishing
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: this is the read-back/init counterpart of the Submodule.add config write the fix had to change at base.py:610

O9_family: CWE-200 / CWE-214 - exposure of secret environment-variable values by expanding them into URLs that are written to git config and passed to git

O10_build.toolchain: pip + pyproject.toml (setuptools), pytest with test-requirements.txt, a system git binary on PATH
O10_build.project_tests: test/test_clone.py (test_clone_from_unsafe_protocol, test_clone_from_unsafe_options), test/test_remote.py, test/test_submodule.py, test/test_util.py (test_cygpath_ok / test_cygpath_norm_ok), test/test_git.py

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add expand_vars=False only at the reported call site git/remote.py:811 (or regex-strip ${...} from the URL), leaving the clone command, the post-clone stored-url rewrite and the Cygwin cygpath path untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Repo path expansion outside this advisory: git/repo/base.py:234-246 calls git.util.cygpath / expand_path on the repository path, and the cygpath call ignores the caller's expand_vars argument - this belongs to the earlier advisory GHSA-rwj8-pgh3-r573, not to the URL protection screened here.
